articles.title: How to Write Weekly Reports That Sound Human
articles.subtitle: A real workflow from raw data to final draft — every step, with screenshots and the reasoning behind it.
articles.verdict: Claude is currently the best AI for writing weekly reports that read like a human colleague wrote them — not a template.
articles.getting_started:
1. Go to claude.ai and sign up for free.
2. Start a new conversation and paste your raw data (numbers, bullet points, meeting notes).
3. Use this prompt structure: "Turn these notes into a weekly report for [team]. Keep it under 400 words. Use specific numbers, not vague phrases like 'significant improvement.'"
articles.pricing: Free tier: enough for most weekly report use cases (roughly 30 messages per few hours). Pro: $20/month if you need heavy daily usage.
articles.comparison:
vs ChatGPT: Claude produces less formulaic, more natural-sounding reports. ChatGPT tends to default to "In conclusion" patterns.
vs Jasper: Jasper is built for marketing copy, not internal reports — overkill and wrong tone.
articles.scenarios: Weekly status reports, monthly summaries, team standup notes, project updates to stakeholders
